metadata.datasource: From Fujifilm's AF3-0252E2 (2019), FUJICOLOR CRYSTAL ARCHIVE PROFESSIONAL PAPER MAXIMA, D-max aims 2.55/2.55/2.45 (as in CLP013 rev-E); it plots the same dyes and sensitivities as DP II's sheet of that year, so it takes DP II's own, from AF3-212E (2005), with its characteristic curves; vector plots, read on their own frames and rules (fuji_paper_sheets.py). Its dyes and spectral sensitivity are DP II's, as its own sheet's plots are, the dyes spectral reflection densities normalised to 1.0, put on agx's dye-amount scale (a unit of each reads in its own Status A channel what a unit of agx's Fujifilm Crystal Archive Type II's does); the sensitivities relative log sensitivity at D-min + 1.0, one scale for the three, each layer's level where its curve reaches D-min + 1.0 (+0.117/+0.098/+0.080 decades from mid-grey); its characteristic curves are DP II's (Fujifilm plots none for it), each layer's density over D-min scaled so its top moves by its own D-max aim less DP II's (+0.20/+0.20/+0.20 R/G/B): Fujifilm aims all its papers 0.15-0.20 under their flashed black (CLP013 rev-E), and koraks' measurements of Type CA beside DP II ('On a Color Mission', tinker.koraks.nl, 2025) find the two alike in exposure and apart in D-max (DP II's: laser exposure, CP-48S, Status A). Base: the curves' D-min, R 0.100 G 0.100 B 0.063, as fog and stain, the dyes in the amounts that read it. Not on the sheets, taken as agx takes them for its papers: printed with agx's TH-KG3 lamp and viewed in D50; log H 0 in each layer where it forms its share of a neutral grey of 18.4% luminance (Status A 0.748/0.787/0.792); collects as much of the lamp as agx's Type II, each through its own filtration for Kodak Portra 400 (here M 60.1 Y 83.2, Type II's M 68.4 Y 76.8), a shift of -0.608 decades. Black, the curves' top as fitted: Status A 2.87/2.73/2.68. Fujifilm Europe's redrawn dye and sensitivity plots (2014 on, one set for all three papers) differ from these and are not used.
